artworks.title: Portrait of a Group, Yale University
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts six individuals standing outdoors in a grassy area. There are four men and a child to the right of a tree, with one man and the child on the left. The child is in the center, wearing a hat and a dark jacket. The men are dressed in suits, waistcoats, bowler hats, and some wear bow ties. The individuals' facial features and hair are partially obscured. In the background, there are two buildings, one resembling a house with visible windows and shutters, and the other a larger structure, possibly an institutional building. There is a fence and trees in the area.

artworks.title: The Artist's Daughter Eleonora Reclining on a Chaise-Longue
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on light blue multicolor fiber wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person's upper body in a reclining position. The person is leaning back with their eyes closed and a serene expression. They have short hair and are wearing a ruffled dress with intricate patterns. There are no visible accessories or objects in the image. The background is plain.

artworks.title: A Summer Evening at the Lago Maggiore
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper, mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a winding path bordered by rocks and shrubs. In the distance, there is a village with houses and a building with a small tower, potentially a church. Mountains rise behind the village, leading to a horizon with a lake extending towards distant hills and mountains. The painting has delicate yet detailed brushstrokes, using warm colors like earthy browns, lush greens, and shades of blue and purple.

artworks.title: Seated Boy
artworks.medium: black and red chalk and graphite on cardboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Priscilla Mason Trust
artworks.description: This is a portrait sketch showing the upper body of a young child. The child is sitting with one knee raised and their arms resting casually on it. They have short, dark hair that is parted to the side. Their facial features are soft with a gentle expression and subtle blush on the cheeks. The child is dressed in a light-colored, high-collared garment with soft, fluffy detailing around the neck. The background is a simple, slightly textured surface. No objects or jewelry are visible in the image.

artworks.title: Greek Sailors on a Venetian Canal
artworks.medium: watercolor over black chalk and graphite, heightened with white on blue-gray wove paper, faded to tan
artworks.description: The image shows six people on a small wooden boat. They are facing away from the viewer, standing close together and holding various objects. They are wearing loose-fitting garments with headwear like hats and caps. One person is wearing a red fez. The boat has crossed oars and a large flag at the back. The background is simple.

artworks.title: Schloss Lauter zwischen Creutznach u. Zweibrücken an d. Lauter
artworks.medium: graphite with brown wash on wove paper from a sketchbook
artworks.description: In the image, there is a delicate sketch of a castle complex. The castle is centrally positioned, with detailed architectural features depicted in fine lines and minimal color. The horizon is suggested by the castle structures and faint shading below them. The artwork features light brushstrokes, possibly ink or pencil with soft watercolor elements. The color palette is muted, with light browns and soft greys against a cream background. There are no vivid colors present, creating a calm visual presentation. The large surrounding space of neutral paper enhances focus on the castle details.

artworks.title: Schloss Landstuhl b. Kaisers, Lautern, den Prinzen v. Sickingen gehürig
artworks.medium: graphite with brown wash on wove paper from a sketchbook
artworks.description: The image shows a castle on a hill. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, displaying the castle's structure with multiple towers and a central building. The background is blank, emphasizing the castle. Delicate lines outline the castle, with light brown and beige washes suggesting texture. The color palette is subtle and antiquated, with sparse touches of color highlighting the linework.

artworks.title: Das alte Schloss Gutenfeis bei Caub am Rhein
artworks.medium: graphite with brown wash on wove paper from a sketchbook
artworks.description: The image depicts a castle on a hill, viewed from a slightly elevated angle to capture the structure against the sky. The horizon is not clearly defined, with the castle standing out prominently. It is drawn in a detailed, delicate style with soft sepia tones. The landscape beneath the castle is subtly shaded, contrasting with the blank sky above.

artworks.title: Schloss Windeck b. Weinhelm a. d. Bergstrasse
artworks.medium: graphite with brown wash on wove paper from a sketchbook
artworks.description: The image features a side view of a castle on a small hill, showcasing its towers and battlements in the center. The horizon line is not visible. The artwork demonstrates detailed linework and subtle wash techniques, creating a light and airy appearance. The color scheme is mainly soft earthy tones like browns and creams. The background is empty, highlighting the castle.

artworks.title: Das Schloss zu Kaiserslautern
artworks.medium: graphite with brown wash on wove paper from a sketchbook
artworks.description: The image shows a medieval town or castle complex on a gentle slope. The cluster of buildings has tall towers, gabled roofs, and a fortified wall that spans horizontally towards the right. The artwork uses precise linework and brown ink washes for tonal depth. The color palette is warm with browns and beige tones against a light background. The scene offers an unobstructed view of the architectural details.

artworks.title: Schloss Lindenfels bei Weinheim im Odenwald
artworks.medium: graphite with brown wash on wove paper from a sketchbook
artworks.description: This image shows an elevated view of a castle and a small town surrounding it on a hill. The horizon is unclear, possibly obscured by the hill. The artwork features delicate brushstrokes, light brown washes for shading, and warm earthy tones. Some distant structures are faintly outlined, while closer elements show intricate details such as pointed towers and rooftops.

artworks.title: Study for an Allegory of Painting
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing shows a seated person in a three-quarter angle facing right. Their left leg is bent, and right leg is stretched out. They have delicate facial features and hair in an updo, possibly with a ribbon. The person wears a draped garment and holds an elongated object in their right hand. The background is a plain textured surface typical of a paper sketch.

artworks.title: A Spanish Dancer
artworks.medium: charcoal with gray wash and pastel on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person in a dynamic pose. The figure is depicted from head to toe with one arm raised overhead. The sketch emphasizes fluid motion, with simple facial features and clothing suggestive of movement. The background is plain with the artist's signature visible. The artwork is in a monochromatic palette, likely charcoal.

artworks.title: Treasury of Reims Cathedral
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.description: The image shows religious artifacts arranged on a surface. The artifacts include crosses and reliquaries. The artifacts are arranged neatly on a draped surface. The color palette is sepia-toned. There is writing on the wall behind the objects.

artworks.title: A Penitent at a Quaker Sermon
artworks.medium: brush and brown wash with white heightening on paper washed gray brown
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring multiple figures and objects. The image depicts figures intertwined in an interior space. There is a use of chiaroscuro, with light highlighting certain figures. The setting includes wooden stools and an urn in the background, implying a classical or historical context. Various forms and outlines in the painting hint at fabrics and textures, creating an aged texture. This is in the style of Peter Paul Rubens.

artworks.title: Grand Châtaignier au Bord d'un Chemin (Large Chestnut Tree on the Side of a Road)
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a large tree dominating the right side of the scene. The view is from ground level, with a dirt path winding to the left. The horizon is low, with an open field stretching into the distance. Smaller leafless trees are scattered in the background. The image is monochromatic with primarily sepia tones, highlighting the texture of the tree bark. Shadows from the branches create lines across the path.

artworks.title: Sun Cycle Taken Dec 21-17. Looking South from Gov. Hill
artworks.medium: gelatin silver print

artworks.title: Chiesa et Hospitale de Mendicanti (plate 35)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.dimensions:
page size: 27 x 35.2 cm (10 5/8 x 13 7/8 in.)
overall size (volume closed): 28.3 x 36.9 x 3 cm (11 1/8 x 14 1/2 x 1 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection, David K.E. Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of the Church and Hospital of the Mendicanti with a canal scene. The perspective is slightly elevated, showing the architecture and canal activity below. Various structures and buildings are visible, creating depth. The building on the right has columns and statues. The lines are detailed, capturing textures. The color palette is sepia, typical of a pen and ink drawing. Gondolas are on the canal, with human figures nearby. In the background, there are more buildings and a bridge over the canal.

artworks.title: Facciata della Chiesa del'Ospitaletto (plate 33)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.dimensions:
page size: 27 x 35.2 cm (10 5/8 x 13 7/8 in.)
overall size (volume closed): 28.3 x 36.9 x 3 cm (11 1/8 x 14 1/2 x 1 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection, David K.E. Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural drawing of a church facade viewed from a straight-on perspective. The horizon is not distinctly marked due to the architectural focus, but the structure itself creates a natural skyline. Ornate figures are positioned atop the building's roofline. The brushstrokes, though etching on paper is the medium, emphasize the detailed line work throughout, highlighting the elaborate architectural details and figures carved into the building. The color palette remains monochromatic, in shades of gray and sepia. Closest to us is an open plaza where small groups of people, some in conversation and others engaged in various activities. The detailed embellishments of the church and the figures hint at a renaissance style, drawing the viewer into the historical and cultural significance of the setting.

artworks.title: Pont de L'estelle sur le gave, près Bétharram, Basses Pyrénées (The Estelle Bridge on the Gave, near Bétharram, Basses-Pyrénées)
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Carolyn S. Brody Family Foundation Fund and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an old stone bridge crossing a calm body of water. The river reflects the bridge and surrounding nature. Ivy covers the stone bridge, giving it texture. Near the bridge, there is a small building with a covered porch. Mountains in the distance are covered in a light mist. The color palette is sepia, giving the image a timeless and serene quality.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Family
artworks.medium: palladium print

artworks.title: René François Armand Prudhomme
artworks.medium: graphite with white heightening on buff laid paper
artworks.description: This is a pencil drawing of a man from the chest up, creating a three-quarter length portrait. The man is facing slightly to the side but looking directly at the viewer. He has a full, bushy beard, a prominent mustache, slicked back hair and a neutral expression. He is wearing a buttoned-up shirt with visible folds and suspenders. The background is a plain, textured surface. The artist's signature is visible on the right side of the drawing.

artworks.title: Approaching Morestal
artworks.medium: black chalk over graphite with gray and brown wash and blue watercolor on pale blue paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 24.1 × 35 cm (9 1/2 × 13 3/4 in.) (approximate size; object mounted)
mount: 34.2 × 35 cm (13 7/16 × 13 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a landscape with trees, structures, and a winding path. The horizon is high, featuring faint outlines of mountains, rooftops, and a delicate spire. The artwork uses delicate brushstrokes and soft lines with a muted color palette of grays, browns, and hints of blue. The terrain and trees in the foreground have a rough texture, contrasting with the misty elements in the distance.

artworks.title: A Pistoia [In Pistoia]
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Gift in Honor of Carlotta Owens
artworks.description: The image displays a street scene from a low angle, featuring tall stone buildings lining a narrow alley. Detailed line work with hatching and cross-hatching creates texture on the walls and cobblestone path. The monochromatic color palette focuses on shades of gray to depict depth. Close by, horizontal lines denote a cobblestone path, while distant figures enhance the urban ambiance. The sky is barely visible amidst the tall buildings.
